paragraphs.text: A few days after the hot dog party, Bill, Michelle, and Nick went to the reservation to meet Pam.
She promised Nick a writing lesson with her uncle at four o'clock.
The four friends were sitting outside the stable when Professor Massey drove up in his jeep.
Hi! Where's George? Professor Massey asked.
Massey slowly walked into the stable.
Very bad news, said Professor Massey sadly.
The sheriff and his men are coming to arrest you for the murder of Richardson.
You're one of my best friends.
This is a terrible mistake, Dan.
What about Luke Langley who escaped to Mexico?
Why did he suddenly go to Mexico?
Please calm down, George, said Professor Massey.
You're right about Langley, but he's out of the country and the Mexican police will probably never find him.
Is that a good reason to arrest me?
Said George, who was very angry.
What will happen to the good name of the reservation and to our business here?
Suddenly Michelle started looking at Professor Massey's personalized license plate.
Look at the professor's license plate.
The four friends immediately moved away from the stable and forgot about Nick's writing lesson.
Nick took out his digital camera and quickly took a picture of the license plate.
Hasn't anyone ever noticed his license plate?
People don't think about license plates.
At that moment, the sheriff's car drove up and stopped in front of the stable.
Sheriff Lopez and one of his men went inside and arrested George.
When Pam saw her uncle walking out of the stable with the sheriff, she ran to him and said,
You know I'm not the murderer, Pam?
And one day the truth will come out.
He got into the sheriff's car and was taken to Ventura County Prison.
Everyone knows your uncle didn't kill Richardson.
We already have our first clue.
Let's find out who Massey really is and why he has the anagram of Ucat on his jeep.
Let's go to your house, Michelle, and look on the web.
But first, let me tell Wild Wolf and the others what's happening.
She ran down the hill to the Chumash Museum.
When she came back, her eyes were red, and she said.
No one on this reservation has ever been arrested.
Wild Wolf said that we're the only ones who can help Uncle George.
Do you remember that night in the forest?
Of course we do, said Bill.
Wild Wolf said we have a pure heart and we must find Ucat.
The four friends went back to Portola Point.
Bought some takeout pizzas and went home.
Said Mrs. Martin opening the front door.
What are you doing with six pizzas?
This is going to be a long night.
We're having pizza in my room and working on the web.
I bought two extra pizzas for you and Dad.
Are you working on another mystery?
Said Michelle, running upstairs to Bill's room.
Mrs. Martin looked at them and thought.
